verdict.rationale: PayPal documents an official MCP server that lets merchants use natural language from their MCP clients. A runtime probe confirms a live remote MCP endpoint at mcp.paypal.com/mcp with RFC 9728 OAuth protected-resource metadata, and the agent toolkit, which also lists MCP support, is published on npm. Missing for 10: client-specific connection and setup steps, and independent community corroboration of real agent sessions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: PayPal built an MCP server that lets merchants use natural language with their favorite MCP clients.
PayPal's remote MCP server is live

The PayPal Agent Toolkit enables popular agent frameworks including OpenAI's Agent SDK, LangChain, Vercel's AI SDK, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate with PayPal APIs through function calling.
